messages:
Lina Chau: quick handoff — Opal Systems closed on Dedicated (12mo) today. Primary contacts: erin@opal.co (IT), sam.ops@opal.co (platform). Renewal: Jan 2027 but finance asked for monthly usage reporting.

Lina Chau: current status: initial invoice paid, provisioning requested; they want private/VPC later this year. Onboarding kickoff scheduled next Tue.

Mike Reddy: thanks — what are immediate blockers from sales side? any SSO, certs, data residency flags?

Lina Chau: SSO: they use Okta; need SAML metadata + attribute mapping. Data residency: must stay in eu-west region for PII by EOW next month. Also flagged rate limits: expect bursty traffic (20k req/day, spikes to 2k/min).

Jess Park: noted. I'll own onboarding. Can we get SAML metadata and an initial runbook for traffic shaping?

Lina Chau: uploading SAML metadata to shared Confluence doc — https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/Opal+Systems+Handoff 

Lina Chau: also dropping the okta metadata here:

Lina Chau: ```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://opal.okta.com/saml2">
  <!-- trimmed -->
  <Attribute name="email" />
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Mike Reddy: Ash / eng: can you confirm infra for eu-west private instance and if we can reserve capacity for expected bursts? tagging @Ash Kaur

Ash Kaur: I can provision a Dedicated pool in eu-west. Need expected model config (seq len, model family) and KV cache size. For SAML we'll need test SP metadata and a staging domain.

Lina Chau: ops shared model profile: "redwood-std-gpt4-open" baseline; typical seq len ~1024. I'll paste sample workload later.

Jess Park: action list: 1) Ash to open infra ticket to reserve eu-west pool (owner: Ash, due: 3 business days). 2) Sales to provide full SAML metadata + cert (owner: Lina, due: EOD tomorrow). 3) CS (Jess) schedule kickoff + enablement (owner: Jess, kickoff Tue 10am PT). 4) Finance reporting: Tara to set up monthly usage dashboard (owner: Tara, due: next Wed).

Tara Nguyen: I can do dashboards. Please add Opal billing account ID to the billing portal and give me RBAC.

Lina Chau: billing account id is OPS-9932 — adding to Confluence.

Ash Kaur: opening infra ticket now: ENG-4082 — provisioning eu-west dedicated pool, initial capacity 4x A100 equiv. ETA 48h.

deploy-bot: ENG-4082 has been created by Ash Kaur.

Mike Reddy: great. Risk callouts: SSO cert rotation cadence (they require quarterly), and a potential procurement delay on private networking that could push the private deploy to Q4. We should document fallback: hosted API with encrypted tunnels until private is ready.

Jess Park: noted — I'll prepare fallback runbook and pre-auth flows for the hosted route. Will also capture post-kickoff feedback checklist: SLA expectations, billing cadence, failure recovery steps.

Lina Chau: Opal asked about cost-optimization — they want guidance on batching and KV cache to reduce token costs. Ash / devs: can we precompute a suggested batching config for their 2k/min spikes?

Ash Kaur: yes — we'll provide recommended batching (max_batch: 32, max_latency_ms: 50) and KV cache settings. I'll attach a short JSON snippet to the ticket.

Ash Kaur: ```json
{
  "max_batch": 32,
  "max_latency_ms": 50,
  "kv_cache_size": "8GB"
}
```

Mike Reddy: final ask: capture customer enablement feedback during first 2 weeks. Jess — can you create a short survey and set a reminder to review with product in week 3?

Jess Park: will do. Survey questions will cover onboarding clarity, latency satisfaction, billing clarity, and docs gaps.

Lina Chau: thanks team. Owners recap in Confluence page. I'll ping tomorrow with Okta cert. :thumbsup:

Tara Nguyen: marking billing tasks in my queue.

Jess Park: assigning CS pre-kickoff checklist to Opal thread.

Mike Reddy: closing the loop — if any blocker appears ping #eng-oncall and tag me.

Lina Chau: thanks all :rocket:
